newsitem.title: USA: Union Switch & Signal names pres/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Union Switch & Signal names pres/CEO.

text.p: Union Switch & Signal Inc said Friday it has named Kevin Riddett president and chief executive.

Riddett succeeds Walter Alessandrini, who is resigning to become president and chief executive of an unnamed company that was described as a larger American-based multinational company in a different industry.
Most recently, Riddett was vice president of the Wayside Control Products division of Union Switch & Signal.
Riddett's appointment is effective November 15. Alessandrini will remain on the board of directors.
Union Switch & Signal did not immediately return a telephone call.
A spokesman for Union Switch & Signal said later on Friday that it was not disclosing Alessandrini's new employer because that company had yet to announce the appointment.
